item.title: Tell NYT, Atlantic, USA Today to keep Wayback Machine
item.description:
📝 The news isn’t getting preserved in the Wayback Machine anymore because major media outlets are blocking it. Since February of this year, the New York Times has told the Internet Archive to stop its Wayback Machine from preserving the work of its journalists. The Wayback Machine makes every online news outlet it archives more resilient against pressure to remove stories that threaten the powerful.
🔗 Read more: https://www.savethearchive.com/newsleaders/

item.description:
